listing.name: The Wind Waker Recomp
listing.summary: Explore The Wind Waker Recomp and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Understand the current development limit
steps.instruction: This project currently demonstrates the Wind Waker renderer and framework, with the frame loop driven manually; it is not yet the game. Its Windows ww_launcher.exe is that development renderer. Follow upstream’s developer instructions with your own disc/main.dol only if you are preparing or retaining this experimental renderer; preserve its working directory and documented --iso arguments. Do not select gcrecomp_recompiler.exe as the runtime. A playable game route still requires upstream runtime completion.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep any existing prepared development copy in a separate folder you control. Portcove can retain a non-owning registration of that runtime after read-only executable review; launching remains a separate explicit action. You or upstream keep its updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not supply a playable package, replace this runtime, or back it up or roll it back.
